paper_title: First search for axion dark matter with a Madmax prototype
notes: First axion DM search with a dielectric haloscope (MADMAX CB200 prototype in CERN Morpurgo 1.6 T magnet). 95% CL upper limits on |g_agamma| in two mass windows: 76.56-76.82 ueV and 79.31-79.53 ueV. Best limit ~2e-11 GeV^-1 stated in text at peak sensitivity (~76.74 ueV, config 1 run at 18.557 GHz). No numerical table in the paper (full data on Zenodo); data points here are approximate reconstructions from the text and Fig. 4: values near boost-factor peaks (18.531/18.543/18.557 GHz and 19.196/19.215 GHz, converted via m = 4.136e-15 * f) with limits degrading toward ~1e-10 GeV^-1 at the window edges. Assumes rho_a = 0.3 GeV/cm^3, standard Maxwell-Boltzmann halo (sigma_v = 156 km/s, v_lab = 242 km/s). | selector: text (sole candidate) | axis-peek for confusable-family text read (#625 Phase 3c)
